name: security-hardening
description: Harden an existing application against common vulnerabilities
request_pattern: Security-harden the existing codebase. Address: ${vulnerabilities}. Add input sanitization, parameterized queries, CSRF protection, rate limiting, and secure headers. Never store secrets in code. Add security-focused tests.

variables.vulnerabilities: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, auth bypass, insecure direct object references
